SG1.statement: The BJB shall not open the main contactors while the vehicle is in motion.
SG1.safe_state: Contactors held closed, torque limited, driver warning.

SG2.statement: The BJB shall open the main contactors within 500 ms of a detected HV isolation fault.

evidence.rationale: Cycle-by-cycle comparison of redundant core outputs.

ECC_SRAM.name: SECDED ECC on data SRAM with background scrub

evidence.rationale: Single-bit correct, double-bit detect. Scrub period 10 ms.
Q/A protocol; incorrect or late answer de-asserts enable.

CONTACTOR_FB.name: Contactor position feedback with plausibility check

evidence.rationale: Aux contact state compared against commanded state each 10 ms.

POWERUP_TEST.name: Power-up self test of gate driver path

evidence.rationale: Driver output toggled against feedback before contactor close.

core_halt.effect: No command issued; driver enable decays, contactors open

sram_bitflip.effect: Corrupted state variable, possible spurious open command

clock_drift.effect: Timing of contactor control loop out of spec

io_stuck.effect: Enable line stuck; contactor command not conveyed

output_stuck_off.effect: Contactor cannot be held closed -> opens while driving

output_stuck_on.effect: Contactor cannot be opened on isolation fault

sense_offset.effect: Coil current misreported; no immediate goal violation

sense_open.effect: Coil current unreadable; plausibility check degraded

output_stuck_high.effect: Watchdog never trips — diagnostic lost, no direct violation

output_stuck_low.effect: Spurious reset, enable de-asserts, contactors open in motion

supply_short.effect: Loss of watchdog supply, enable de-asserts

open.effect: Feedback reads low; plausibility check degraded

short.effect: Feedback reads closed regardless of true state

drift.effect: Threshold margin reduced, still within detection band

welded_closed.effect: Contactor cannot open on isolation fault

coil_short.effect: Driver current limit trips, contactor opens

A1.statement: Vehicle lifetime of 15000 operating hours per OEM mission profile.

A2.statement: Power-up self test executes on every drive cycle; no key-on is skipped.

A3.statement: Lockstep comparator and external watchdog have no shared failure cause. Required before dc_combination may be set to 'independent'.

mcu_lockstep.description: Automotive MCU, lockstep core pair, ECC SRAM, internal monitors

core_corrupt.description: Erroneous computation, both cores unaffected by common cause

sram_bitflip.description: Single/double bit error in data SRAM

gate_driver.description: High-side contactor gate driver with current sense

contactor_coil.description: Main HV contactor coil and mechanism
